desc: Parse N, K, and A from stdin.
Compute total_xor = XOR of all elements in A.
Handle K == N (empty excluded set yields total_xor) and K == 1 via the general complement logic.
Let r = N - K. If K <= r, enumerate all combinations of A of size K, compute XOR of each tuple, track the maximum.
If K > r, enumerate all combinations of A of size r as excluded elements, compute candidate = total_xor XOR XOR(excluded), track the maximum.
Test on sample 1 and sample 2, plus edge cases K=1, K=N, K=N-1, and duplicate values -- all public samples passed.
Verify performance: at most C(N,K) <= 10^6 combinations, each XOR over min(K, N-K) <= 11 elements.
